statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-15588 is a denial of service in the GDBus server authentication code in GLib (gio/gdbusauth.c): the server reads each authentication line from a connecting client with no length limit, so an unauthenticated peer that can reach a GDBusServer can make it consume unbounded memory and CPU. Upstream fixed it in GLib 2.88.3 (https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/issues/3985, https://gitlab.gnome.org/GNOME/glib/-/commit/4235f7b42ba51d6fdb4abd7c4276031802f39834), and Debian backported the fix to trixie in 2.84.4-3~deb13u4 (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-15588, Debian bug #1142835). This owner rebuilds Debian's trixie glib2.0 source. We unpacked libglib2.0-0t64 from every published build for amd64 and arm64. The three builds of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u3 do not carry the fix: their package changelog has no entry for this CVE, and their libgio-2.0 library lacks the 'Malformed D-Bus authentication line' error that the fix adds. The three builds of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u5 do: their changelog includes the 2.84.4-3~deb13u4 entry that backports the upstream 2.88.3 fix for this CVE, and their libgio-2.0 contains that error message. The range ends at the first build of Debian 2.84.4-3~deb13u5, the first published build with the fix.
